LanguageData.CQF_MP_Invalid: Could not apply these projection settings. Enter whole numbers, keep both areas within their maps, use a resolution of 128–4096 pixels and a refresh interval of 1–60 frames. See the log for details.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_PreviewTip: Shows the entire source map. Choose Select area, then drag a rectangle on the preview to crop it.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_CropTip: Drag with the left mouse button to select the area to display. Right-click or press Esc to cancel the current selection.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_ModeTip: Display only is for observation. Play mode supports selecting units, buildings and items, using native commands, and zooming and panning inside the viewport. All objects remain on the source map.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_LayerTip: Above terrain draws the projection over the host map. Beneath terrain lets you view it through open space or terrain gaps; opaque terrain hides it.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_PlacementTip: Drag on the host map to place the projection. Drag inside it to move it, or drag a corner to resize it. Right-click or press Esc to cancel the current drag.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_NavigateTip: Left-click to select objects, drag to select a group, and right-click to issue orders. Use the wheel to zoom this viewport and drag with the middle mouse button to pan. Map movement and zoom keys also work while the pointer is inside. Click the host map or Return to host map to switch back.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_LayoutTip: Use this mode to adjust the source area, window position and size. Choose Finish and play to select and interact with objects inside the viewport.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_AllowZoomTip: Allow the mouse wheel and map zoom keys to change this viewport's zoom. Disable this to keep the current zoom level.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_MatchCellSizeTip: Each source cell occupies one host cell. The source area determines the window size. This setting locks zoom and prevents stretching.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_NavigateLockedTip: Left-click to select objects, drag to select a group, and right-click to issue orders. Zoom is locked by this viewport's configuration. Drag with the middle mouse button to pan within the available source area. Click the host map or Return to host map to switch back.
LanguageData.CQF_MP_CellSizeTooLarge: The source area is too large to fit in the host map at 1:1 cell size. Select a smaller source area.
